meta.holidayNote: Use dayType 'holiday' only for official Bulgarian public holidays that fall on Monday-Friday. Saturday and Sunday always use the weekend timetable, even when they are public holidays. For lines 1, 3 and 4, the published timetable has weekday and holiday columns only; the weekday timetable therefore also applies on Saturdays and Sundays.
